name: Sarutobi Jonin

entries.name: Adept Elementalist
entries.text: Select one damage type. Increase damage dealt with that type by 1 die and gain resistance to it.

entries.name: Advanced Chakra Transformation
entries.text: You cannot have your chakra molding removed by any means.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.text: When subjected to a Dexterity saving throw, take no damage on a success.

entries.name: Torque Casting
entries.text: Once per round, when casting a Ninjutsu or Genjutsu while affected by an Elemental Condition, reduce its rank by 1 and add 1 damage die to your jutsu. That jutsu gains the release keyword that would inflict that condition.

entries.name: Unlimited Potential
entries.text: When you Clash, you roll with advantage; your opponent rolls with disadvantage.

entries.name: Zenith
entries.text: All of your jutsu are automatically upcast by 1 rank.

entries.name: Will of Fire (Reaction)
entries.text: When an ally is reduced to 0 HP within 60 ft., gain 1 Legendary Resistance (max 2).

entries.name: Caster Passive 1
entries.text: Effects that prevent chakra molding end at the end of your turn.

entries.name: Caster Passive 2
entries.text: Area-damaging Ninjutsu (Cone, Line, Radius, Cylinder) can be reshaped: Cone = 30 ft. | Line = 60 ft./5 ft. | Radius = 25 ft. | Cylinder = 20 ft. wide/30 ft. tall.

entries.name: Caster Action
entries.text: Cost: 2 Tenacity dice. Overcharge: the next Ninjutsu cast cannot be interrupted. Add spent dice to damage. If 2+ creatures fail the save or the jutsu beats AC by 5+, the target is Staggered until the end of their next turn.

All Sarutobi adversaries gain access to an additional Nature Release and its related jutsu (see Specialist Jutsu Lists). They also gain bonus defensive jutsu depending on their releases: Blue Fire, Water Shield, Bedrock Skin, Blurring Wind, Lightning Repel.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: Make 3 attacks. May spend a bonus action for a fourth.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.
Takes 1 Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn to move, attack, cast a jutsu, or gain an extra reaction. Regains Elite Actions at the start of its turn.

notes: The Sarutobi Elemental Specialization sidebar on p.26 applies to every Sarutobi block and is repeated on each.
